messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning a small UI deploy tomorrow at 10:00 UTC. Need a quick checklist: are assets versioned correctly? canary plan? CDN invalidation scope? smoke checks and rollback readiness. Who can run this?

sam: I can run it. Assets are content-hash named, but we did change the service-worker scope so index.html needs cache-busting header. Plan: canary 10% eu-west + 10% us-east for 15m, then ramp if no errors. Rollback is to the previous tag pinned in k8s; I’ll keep the old replica set ready for fast rollback.

infra-bot: Deploy job scheduled: depl-2026-04-31-12 (manual trigger window: 09:50-10:00 UTC). CI build ID: 8672. Canary routing will use traffic-split policy.

oliver: QA checklist request: can you paste the exact smoke steps so I can run them and have sign-off ready at 10:05? Also who’s watching console logs?

sam: Smoke steps (short):
1) Hit /health and expect 200 and {"status":"ok"}
2) Load /console as a new session (incognito) — confirm main bundle served and version hash present in HTML
3) Open devtools console — no uncaught exceptions within first 30s
4) Verify critical endpoints (GET /api/v1/user, /api/v1/models) respond < 500 and < 500ms median
5) Run quick e2e: login -> open workspace -> open model config (script)

Example quick checks:```bash
curl -sSf https://console.redwood.ai/health
curl -sSf -I https://console.redwood.ai/ | grep -i ETag
# smoke e2e runner (local): ./scripts/smoke-runner --env=staging --suite=console-smoke
```

sam: CDN invalidation plan: we will NOT purge the whole /assets/ prefix. We will:
- purge index.html and service-worker scope only (so users pick up new shell)
- rely on hashed asset filenames for static bundles so no global purge
- set short TTL for index for 30m after deploy

Devex: Suggestion — use surrogate-key tagging for index + api responses so we can purge with a single key if needed. Also use Fastly soft-purge for index rather than hard ban to avoid cache stampede.

sam: Fastly purge command I’ll run if needed:```bash
curl -X POST https://api.fastly.com/service/FASTLY_SVC_ID/purge -H "Fastly-Key: $FASTLY_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"surrogate_key":"console-index"}'
```

jess: Product note — don’t flip any experiment flags during canary. We need the same experiment config to compare metrics. If we need experiments toggled, do it post-ramp.

eng-sre: Who’s oncall for rollback/incident if canary shows error?

oliver: Frontend oncall this week is @oliver, and infra oncall is @eng-sre. I’ll standby 09:55-10:20 for smoke.

sam: I’ll trigger canary at 10:00, monitor logs and Sentry for 20m. If any 5xx spike or >2 uncaught exceptions in Sentry within 10m, we rollback. Will post status here and call out via voice if needed. :thumbsup:

maria: Perfect — thanks all. I’ll update the release board and ping stakeholders once canary completes.

infra-bot: Note: scheduled TTL change for /index.html set to 30m post-deploy.

sam: Confirmed — I’ll post final deploy URL + canary traffic split in this thread at 09:58 UTC.
